title: Siman 256
section: The Greatness and Awesomeness of His Attainments

segments.he: (טז) שמעתי בליפוויץ שאמר אני איש פלא ונשמתי הוא פלא גדול:
segments.en: (16.) I heard in Lipovitz that he said: "I am a wondrous person and my soul is a great wonder."
